hints.title: Row Independent Gravity
hints.text: In the original box, gravity acts towards the right edge independently across each row.

hints.title: Right to Left Compaction Pointer
hints.text: Scan each row backwards; maintain a write pointer for the rightmost empty position where falling stones land.

hints.title: Clockwise Coordinate Transformation
hints.text: Map rotated cell (c, m - 1 - r) to hold the value of simulated cell (r, c).

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating stone drops one cell at a time takes O(m * n^2) quadratic operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Two-pointer right-to-left compaction and matrix rotation processes the grid in O(m * n) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate resets the stone landing slot upon encountering an obstacle character.
